build.beforeDevCommand: if [ -f gui/ui/package.json ]; then npm --prefix gui/ui run dev; elif [ -f ui/package.json ]; then npm --prefix ui run dev; else npm run dev; fi
build.beforeBuildCommand: if [ -f gui/ui/package.json ]; then npm --prefix gui/ui run build; elif [ -f ui/package.json ]; then npm --prefix ui run build; else npm run build; fi

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-src 'none'
security.devCsp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost ws://127.0.0.1:1420; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-src 'none'
